svg.title: TORos: a confirmed prototype concept
svg.desc: A conceptual overview of Robin Winters's confirmed TORos description for Yukon Systems. Multimodal input connects to multiple models, their candidate decisions are discussed and challenged, and deliberation aims at a consensus decision. Boxes and arrows illustrate the concept, not a verified execution trace or production architecture. Model count, development dates, collaborators and measured performance are unresolved.

g.text: Built by Robin Winters for Yukon Systems · owner-confirmed contribution
Conceptual relationships, not a verified runtime trace.
Consensus describes the intended process; agreement does not establish correctness.
Exact model count, implementation, project dates, team credits and performance remain unresolved.
Assistant-prepared illustration from the approved record · robin.ac · Company article: May 5, 2025
